 UPTET Syllabus 2027: Check Paper 1 & Paper 2 Subject-Wise Topics, Exam Pattern & Download PDF
 By Siddhi Sharma Last Updated: Nov 19, 2026, 10:30 IST UPTET Syllabus 2027: The UPTET 2027 is an exam that is conducted by the UPESSC, which will take place in February 2027. The UPTET 2027 examination will consist of two parts: Paper 1 for Primary Level (Classes I to V) and Paper 2 for Upper Primary Level (Classes VI to VIII). Both tests have 150 questions with 150 marks each.
 UPTET Syllabus 2027: Check Paper 1 & Paper 2 Subject-Wise Topics, Exam Pattern & Download PDF 
 UPTET Syllabus 2027: The Uttar Pradesh Teacher Eligibility Test (UPTET) 2027 organized by the Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) is a state level qualifying test for those aspirants who intend to become teachers of Primary Classes (I to V) and Upper Primary Classes (VI to VIII) in UP Government Schools and aided schools. The exam will be held offline OMR Mode on 26 and 27 February 2027 to check the aptitude of the candidates for teaching and knowledge of psychology, language, and core subjects. 
 Having an insight into the updated syllabus of the UPTET 2027 will help the candidates concentrate on the topics and chapters that are essential from the examination point of view in both papers. Paper 1 contains five sections- Child Development & Pedagogy, Language-I (Hindi), Language-II (English/Urdu/Sanskrit), Mathematics, and Environmental Studies. Paper 2 follows the same base in terms of Child Development and Languages and gives the option to candidates to take Mathematics and Science or Social Studies. There are 150 Multiple Choice Questions in each paper for 150 marks within 150 minutes without any negative marking.

 UPTET Exam Pattern 2027 (Paper 1 & Paper 2) 
 The UPTET 2027 examination comprises two 150 minute long papers having 150 Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) for 150 marks each. The Paper-I (classes I-V) includes the following subjects CDP, Hindi, Language II, Maths and EVS (all worth 30 marks). The Paper-II (classes VI-VIII) includes CDP, Hindi, Language-II (worth 30 marks each) and Mathematics and Science or Social Studies (worth 60 marks).

 UPTET Syllabus 2027  
 Paper 1 (Classes I to V)  
 According to the UPTET 2027 Paper 1 syllabus (Classes I-V), there are five compulsory subjects worth a total of 150 marks Child Development & Pedagogy, Language-I (Hindi), Language-II (English/Urdu/Sanskrit), Mathematics, and Environmental Studies (EVS). Each of these sections consists of 30 questions assessing basic knowledge of primary-level subjects and psychology. 
 Direct Link for UPTET Syllabus 2027 Paper 1 (Classes I to V)   
 Paper 2 (Classes VI to VIII) 
 The syllabus for the UPTET 2027 Paper 2 (classes VI-VIII) comprises four units worth 150 marks: Child Development and Pedagogy (30), Language-I Hindi (30), Language-II English/Urdu/Sanskrit (30), and subject streams in Mathematics & Science OR Social Studies (60). This is done in order to test the psychology of adolescents, language ability, subject matter of middle school, and teaching methods.
